page: Microsoft Azure DC48es_v6 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the DCEV6 family. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is configured with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning it relies entirely on external storage solutions, though it is designated as Premium Storage capable. There are no onboard GPUs, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or parallel computing tasks. Additionally, the instance does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the DC48es_v6 offers a balanced allocation of dedicated compute cores and memory, aligning with standard general-purpose resource profiles. It is designed for workloads requiring substantial multi-core processing capacity and moderate memory footprints, such as enterprise application hosting, relational databases utilizing network-attached storage, and mid-sized web serving environments.
